sn47.12:5.4: I believe there’s no other ascetic or brahmin—whether past, future, or present—whose direct knowledge is superior to the Buddha’ when it comes to awakening”?
sn47.12:6.10: Those who will be perfected ones, fully awakened Buddhas in the future will give up the five hindrances, corruptions of the heart that weaken wisdom. Their mind will be firmly established in the four kinds of mindfulness meditation. They will correctly develop the seven awakening factors. And they will awaken to the supreme perfect awakening.
sn47.12:6.11: And the Blessed One, sir, who is the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha at present, has given up the five hindrances, corruptions of the heart that weaken wisdom. His mind has been firmly established in the four kinds of mindfulness meditation. He has correctly developed the seven awakening factors. And he has awakened to the supreme perfect awakening’”
